author: Anshul Verma
content: [🤖 Claude Code] Redrawn. Figure 1 is now a flowchart with a start state (my comment or the 5-minute cron), decision points (new comment from me? which kind? does the action delete or reach outside? questions still open on accept? 10 quiet minutes?), the loop back through "sleep until next wake", and an end state. The same rule now applies to every lockstep doc: flows are drawn as flowcharts with decisions, loops, start and end, never as a straight chain of boxes.
